title: The Object Detective
audience: Grades 8–12, first-year undergraduates, online museum visitors
summary: A draft museum label makes bold claims. Walk a living night gallery — dust in the spotlight cones, a ticking grandfather clock, rain on the windows — examine real CC0 Smithsonian 3D scans under a raking torch, magnify and measure them, weigh the catalog records, and write a corrected label that says what you know and how sure you are.

poster.alt: The Lantern Museum gallery after hours (fictional): glass display cases with real Smithsonian CC0 scans under warm tungsten spotlights, glowing floor rings marking where to walk, tall windows with moonlight and rain, and a brass-railed wainscoted wall in oxblood and night blue
